data.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job runs a maintained subset held green: tests known to fail on Windows are deselected through `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/nested-pytest-plugins.args`. This bug owns that file: 27 tests in 5 modules, from the 5 scheduled runs at `b4e0d01b649` (2026-11-15/16).

Tests that launch a nested pytest fail on Windows with `AssertionError: Error while loading plugin "pytest11".` (19) or `root conftest plugin not registered` (8).

Modules: `tests/unit/test_fixture_env_repr_security.py` (14), `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py` (8), `tests/unit/test_environ_assert_repr_security.py` (2), `tests/unit/test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py` (2), `tests/unit/test_nested_pytest_helper.py` (1).

## Approach

Read the full nested output from the sweep log, reproduce the nested invocation on a Windows runner, find why plugin registration differs from Linux, and fix the nested-pytest helper (`tests/_nested_pytest.py`) or the plugin argument it passes. The path form of the `-p` argument and the `PYTHONPATH` separator are hypotheses to test, not conclusions.

## Scope

The nested-pytest helper and the failing tests, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/nested-pytest-plugins.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Testing

POSIX: the touched tests still pass under `make verify`. Windows: a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the change passes with the removed lines no longer deselected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The class's root cause is recorded on this ticket with the evidence that confirmed it.
- [ ] Every line removed from `nested-pytest-plugins.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on that run.
data.title: Windows sweep: nested pytest runs fail to load the pytest11 / root conftest plugin (27 tests)
